positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
● Design, creating wireframes from business requirements, develop workflow
● Project management, keeping to deadlines, removing blockers for developers,
troubleshooting and quality assurance. Keeping project in scope
● Researching modules, troubleshooting code (JavaScript, HTML5)
● Data updates, injecting metadata in HTML5 and JSON formats

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
-Loaded data using proprietary software on a daily, weekly, quarterly and yearly basis. Curated the data in SQL in accordance with company standards and had my data loads checked by a team member for quality assurance. Daily, I was responsible for quality checking my team's data loads.
-Supported work order requests from in-company users across the country by analyzing the feasibility and legitimacy of the requests, and making data updates as needed. Communication to users and team members on various issues.
-Trained with data team members to back up different types of data loads. Was one of the first team members cross trained to work with the rules engine team in setting up bill entry logic rules for the company's proprietary software. Created documentation on data load processes.
-Technical: Microsoft SQL Server 2013, Excel, Word

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
-Supported work orders from end users of a proprietary software based on Tibco MDM from all over the globe. Analysis of existing data cleanup efforts, planning new data setups to support development, maintenance of geologically data. 
-Long-term global data cleanup project using MDM application.  Daily use of data export, import, record creation, data deletion.  Wrote over 50 in-house guides for multitple table impact data updates and other processes.
-Created data setup to support development efforts and quality assurance testing of new or modified features.
-Technical: MDM, SQL, Excel, Word
